beats.title: Fix Merged After Iterative Hardening
beats.body: The PR was merged on February 9, 2018, after the contributor added macOS-specific tests that themselves uncovered additional bugs in symbol parsing and address resolution logic. The reviewer accepted the fix with the Mac test temporarily skipped pending a proper CI environment, acknowledging the broader symbolizer compatibility issues as separate follow-up work.

beats.title: Engineering Lessons
lessons: Tests written to validate a fix often expose latent bugs elsewhere, making them valuable beyond their immediate scope.
Platform-specific behavior differences between CI environments and developer machines can mask test failures that are real and reproducible.
Accepting a fix with a temporarily disabled test is a pragmatic tradeoff when the core correctness improvement is clear and the test infrastructure gap is a known, separable problem.
